description: Lists k6 documentation sections in a hierarchical tree structure. Use this to understand documentation organization and discover related topics. Navigate progressively: start at root, then use root_slug to expand branches. Returns compact metadata (no content) to minimize context usage. Use get_documentation to retrieve the full content for a specific section.

category.description: Optional: Filter by top-level category (e.g., 'using-k6', 'javascript-api'). Use without this parameter to see all categories.

depth.description: Optional: Depth of hierarchy to return (default: 1, max: 5). Depth counts how many levels of children are included in the tree.

root_slug.description: Optional: List the contents under this slug (i.e., its children). Use the slug from a previous list_sections response.

version.description: Optional: k6 version to list sections for (e.g., 'v1.4.x', 'v0.57.x'). Defaults to latest version. Use 'all' to see available versions.

name: list_sections
